anita: fyi rolled out an RBAC mapping tweak last night for the 'access-window' feature and we're seeing unexpected reads from the analytics-temp role to the s3 bucket with model artifacts. I put a soft block on further deploys.
ken: which change exactly and when did it go live?
anita: pushed auth-mapping.yaml @ 02:12Z. snip of relevant section: ```yaml
roles:
  analytics-temp:
    inherits:
      - viewer
    windows:
      - type: access_window
        start: '00:00'
        end: '04:00'
```
mike: that mapping shouldn't grant new s3 permissions unless there was an implicit inherit somewhere. did the viewer role change?
anita: viewer is unchanged. looks like the mapping generator started attaching `session:ephemeral=true` tag and our s3 condition ignores that, causing role to bypass a deny. reproducing locally now.
sec-bot: policy-change detected: `auth-mapping.yaml` modified by anita at 2025-11-03T02:12:07Z (commit 9f3b2a) :rotating_light:
elaine: are there KMS decrypts showing up for the artifact key? we need to know if data was actually exfiltrated or just listed.
anita: cloudtrail shows `Decrypt` calls for `arn:aws:sts::123456:assumed-role/analytics-temp/` between 02:15-02:22Z. sample event id: abcd-1234.
mike: ok emergency plan: 1) push a deny on the s3 bucket for role analytics-temp 2) revoke sessions for that role 3) rotate artifact data key if decrypts confirmed.
ken: agree. can we add a conditional deny tied to the mapping tag? e.g., `NotPrincipalTag/ephemeral = true` so normal flows unaffected.
mike: I'll run a canary deny first. command: `./infractl iam apply --policy-file deny-analytics-temp.json --dry-run=false`
mike: applying now, ETA ~7m.
sec-bot: revoke-sessions job queued by ken.
mike: deny applied to s3 bucket (canary) at 02:30Z. `aws s3api list-objects` calls by analytics-temp now return AccessDenied.
anita: confirmed, decrypt calls stopped at 02:31Z. cloudtrail snippet: "eventName":"Decrypt","errorCode":"AccessDenied"
elaine: opening incident INC-4873, tagging product, legal, and affected customers list.
elaine: INC-4873 created: https://incidents.redwood.ai/INC-4873
mike: we'll also rotate the KMS data key for that artifact key and add a resource-based deny for analytics-temp to be safe.
ken: +1. please include the exact commit that introduced the mapping generator change in the postmortem.
anita: noted — I'll start the timeline and postmortem writeup.
mike: rollback of the mapping generator change is in progress, PR #4221.
anita: thanks all. after postmortem let's add an automated test to catch `principalTag` drift in mapping -> policy translation.
sec-bot: incident INC-4873 severity set to P1 by anita.
ken: recorded, moving to incident channel for follow-ups. :thumbsup:
